name: Biomolecular Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official requirements are available, but Fall 2027 deadlines and waiver availability are not confirmed. Published deadline and waiver pages refer to 2025 or 2026. Admission routes differ by assistantship.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall priority admission and financial assistance
publishedDeadlines.note: Page references Fall 2026; not confirmed for Fall 2027.

publishedDeadlines.label: Late fall applications
publishedDeadlines.note: Page references Fall 2026. Financial assistance depends on availability; contact the program before applying late.

english.note: New TOEFL scale minimum is still being finalized. Scores must be valid when received and sent directly by the provider. An English-medium degree qualifies for exemption only from an approved country; additional proof may be requested.

applicationFee.note: Amount is the international graduate fee. Central admissions cannot waive international graduate fees. Limited program waivers require US citizenship/permanent residence, GPA above 3.50, prerequisites and research experience. Waiver instructions are labelled FA25; confirm current availability.

documents: Personal statement of no more than 1,750 words, including 3–6 faculty interests
International applicants: official transcripts, degree proof, English proficiency and passport name page
requirements.note: Appropriate scientific bachelor or graduate degree and minimum GPA 3.00. International transcripts must be official for review; documents not in English need certified literal translations. No external credential evaluation is required. TA students complete three five-week first-semester rotations; grant-funded RA students may enter with a major advisor and rotations are optional.

funding.note: All PhD applicants are considered automatically for competitive fall teaching assistantships, with tuition and fee waiver, health insurance and an undated annual stipend of $25,000. Funding is not guaranteed. The FAQ describes three years of program funding followed by advisor grant support.

timeline.interviews: Interview invitations typically by mid-February (annual FAQ timing).
timeline.decisions: After interviews, admission and funding decisions usually by mid-March (annual FAQ timing).
